verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' features page explicitly says businesses can connect bank and credit card accounts and automatically import transactions, with bank feeds flowing in automatically and manual statement import as a fallback. The banking API's categorization and reconciliation endpoints corroborate that imported feed transactions are a first-class object. The evidence is marketing-level only, though. Missing for 10: documented daily import cadence or refresh schedule, details on supported banks and feed providers, independent or hands-on corroboration of feed reliability.
